other_conditions: Must be a resident of the Union Territory of Daman & Diu or Dadra & Nagar Haveli
Pregnant women and lactating mothers of any age are eligible
Adolescent girls must be in the age group of 11‑14 years
benefits_summary: Monthly take‑home ration of 7.5 kg of nutritious food (wheat, rice, pulses, jaggery, fortified oil and salt) provided to eligible pregnant women, lactating mothers and adolescent girls.
